text:
sam riley: kicking off a short project to standardize our incident comms snippets and handoff copy. objective: one canonical internal snippet, one canonical external snippet, a tiny "tone cheatsheet", and automation-friendly placeholders. want to reduce on-the-fly wording during pages. open to suggestions. :sparkles:

pager-bot: :rotating_light: [AUTOMATED] Incident opened: INC-20260315-211 | sev=sev2 | service=runtime-proxy-prod | channel=#incidents | link=https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-20260315-211

meera shah: love it. two quick constraints i'd push: 1) internal messages should include runbook link + last deploy hash; 2) external must be single paragraph where possible. also, please include a short "SE/AM copy" for customer-facing threads — they hate long emails. :memo:

oliver grant: for placeholders let's settle on bracketed tokens like [[INC_ID]], [[SEV]], [[SERVICE_LIST]], [[IMPACT_METRIC]], [[ETA]], [[OWNER_CONTACT]], [[RUNBOOK_URL]], [[LAST_DEPLOY_TS]] so our incident tool can safely replace them. prefer `[[...]]` so they are unlikely to collide with other templating.

nina cho: here's a compact internal template for Slack (one snippet to paste):

```
INCIDENT [[INC_ID]] | SEV [[SEV]]
SHORT: [[ONE_LINE]]
IMPACT: [[IMPACT_METRIC]]
RUNBOOK: [[RUNBOOK_URL]]
MITIGATION (current): [[MITIGATION_SUMMARY]]
NEXT ACTION: [[NEXT_STEP]] (owner: [[OWNER_CONTACT]])
LAST DEPLOY: [[LAST_DEPLOY_TS]]
HANDOFF: time [[HANDOFF_TIME]] | from [[HANDOFF_FROM]] -> [[HANDOFF_TO]] | notes: [[HANDOFF_NOTES]]
```

sam riley: nice and scannable. for handoffs let's require a 2-line minimum: 1) one-line status; 2) one-line to-run/avoid. example: `status: degraded, 12% errors; next: revert canary a -> avoid DB rollbacks until failover applied`.

meera shah: thresholds proposal (when to send external/customer notice):
- Any SLO breach affecting >=3% of traffic sustained for >=5 minutes.
- Any incident impacting auth/payments/ingest for any non-zero percentage.
- Any degradation with unknown ETA or ETA >20m.
- Anything likely to trigger customer churn or billing impact -> auto-notify comms.
If none of the above, internal-only until triage reveals otherwise.

oliver grant: also add clause for social media risk: if the incident touches login/payments or 3rd-party outages we should notify comms lead even if percent small.

nina cho: external templates (three tones) 12 short variants so operators can paste quickly. use the bracket placeholders: 

EMPAThetic (use by default if there is visible customer impact):
```
Subject: Were investigating an issue affecting [[SERVICE_LIST]]
Hi l were currently investigating an issue affecting [[SERVICE_LIST]]. Some customers may experience [[IMPACT_METRIC]]. Our engineers are working on a fix and we expect an update by [[ETA]]. We apologize for the disruption. Status: [[STATUS_LINK]]
```

NEUTRAL (no customer action needed):
```
Subject: Degraded performance observed for [[SERVICE_LIST]]
Hi l weve detected degraded performance in [[SERVICE_LIST]]. Performance may be slower for some requests. We are investigating and will update by [[ETA]]. Status: [[STATUS_LINK]]
```

RESOLUTION (post-incident):
```
Subject: Incident resolved l [[SERVICE_LIST]]
Hi l the issue affecting [[SERVICE_LIST]] has been resolved. Root cause (short): [[ROOT_CAUSE_SHORT]]. Impact: [[IMPACT_SUMMARY]]. If you continue to see issues, contact [[SUPPORT_LINK]]. Status: [[STATUS_LINK]]
```

sam riley: whoa some odd escaped characters there — we'll clean before pushing. but structure looks good. add an "AM/SE one-liner" for account teams: `Were investigating an issue affecting [[SERVICE_LIST]]; customers may see [[IMPACT_METRIC]]. Update by [[ETA]]: [[STATUS_LINK]]`. keep it single line.

meera shah: i want a short tone cheatsheet too: 1) apologetic + factual (no speculation), 2) avoid technical jargon in external copy, 3) include next update ETA even if it's "TBD in 15m". Add quick examples operators can copy.

oliver grant: runbook automation: let's make the incident UI export two snippets: `internal_snippet` and `external_snippet`. the generator should fill the bracketed tokens and also optionally create a `handoff_snippet` for the next on-call. call the CLI tool `incident-compose --id [[INC_ID]] --audience internal|external --handoff`.

nina cho: handoff snippet proposal (one Slack line):

```
Handoff | [[INC_ID]] | status: [[CURRENT_STATUS]] | next: [[NEXT_STEP]] | avoid: [[DONT_DO]] | ETA: [[ETA]] | from: [[FROM]] -> [[TO]]
```

sam riley: add `last_successful_deploy` and `current_canary` fields to the internal view. these save time during triage.

meera shah: operational checklist for deciding external comms (three items):
- SLO breach? (yes/no)
- Critical path service? (yes/no)
- ETA unknown or >20m? (yes/no)
If any yes -> create external snippet. If two or more yes -> page comms lead and prepare customer email.

oliver grant: quick legal/safety note: for incidents touching customer data, loop in security + privacy immediately and use the pre-approved security wording in `tone/security.md` in the templates repo.

nina cho: implementation plan: i'll create `infra/incident-templates` with: templates/internal.md, templates/external_emp.md, templates/external_neutral.md, templates/external_resolved.md, tone/cheatsheet.md, generator `incident-compose` to fill tokens. PR by EOD tomorrow.

sam riley: owners + timeline: nina -> repo & generator (EOD tomorrow). meera -> add thresholds + runbook update (Tue). oliver -> integration with incident UI + CLI (end of week). i'll draft a short README for SE/AM one-liners (Mon).

meera shah: small UX ask: add an "external notification" toggle in the incident create flow that auto-generates the external snippet when toggled.

oliver grant: +1. also add a `--tone=empathetic|neutral|resolved` flag to `incident-compose` so callers can pick the template tone.

pager-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder: use `/incident create` to populate canonical fields. This thread tagged: incident-comm-standardization, follow-up: nina-cho, meera-shah, oliver-grant

sam riley: thanks everyone. once nina's PR lands i'll merge and we can start rolling this into the on-call runbooks. ping me if you want to pair on wording examples. :raised_hands:
